name: Bridge deck load test (bench)
notes: Two sequential bench checks on one continuous timeline (no reset between them — intentional). A 10 t midspan load must settle to a ~6 m sag without breaking (assert band verified against a reference semi-implicit-Euler sim); adding 490 t more (500 t total) must snap links. Physics is deck-only spring chain with pinned ends; towers/cable are drawn decoratively. Tests load response, fracture logic and the BENCH contract; visuals are for the blind vote.
